title: Signature Zero Adjustment
description: Signature-original: Sets the instrument reading to zero with zero input applied, removing offset error. Recorded facts — Procedure: Zero Adjustment; Reference: zero standard; Tolerance: 0.1% FS. Used by metrology labs, field scientists, and quality engineers to defend every measurement. Built as a Signature-authored original for the JAH network; clearly labeled Signature and never presented as a public record.
demo:
# Signature Zero Adjustment — runnable demo (python3)
# Zero Adjustment - linear fit check (python3)
xs=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
ys=[0.02, 1.01, 1.99, 3.02, 3.98]
r2min=0.995
n=len(xs)
mx=sum(xs)/n; my=sum(ys)/n
sxy=sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(xs,ys))
sxx=sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xs)
slope=sxy/sxx; icept=my-slope*mx
syy=sum((y-my)**2 for y in ys)
r2=sxy**2/(sxx*syy)
print("y=%.4fx%+.4f R2=%.4f" % (slope, icept, r2))
print("LINEAR" if r2 >= r2min else "NONLINEAR - investigate")
